name: @porsche-design-system/react
author: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG

scripts.build: npm run clean:build && npm run build:react-wrapper && npm run build:react-ssr-wrapper && npm run build:nextjs && npm run build:react-router
scripts.build:react-wrapper: npx rollup -c ./projects/react-wrapper/rollup.config.js --bundleConfigAsCjs && npm run build:subPackages:stylesheets && npm run build:subPackages:tailwindcss && npm run build:typings && npm run build:subPackages:skill && chmod +x dist/react-wrapper/bin/patchRemixRunProcessBrowserGlobalIdentifier.js
scripts.build:subPackages:skill: npm run build:subPackages:skill:content && npm run build:subPackages:skill:bin
scripts.build:subPackages:skill:content: SOURCE=../storefront/projects/skills/generated/react/skills && TARGET=./dist/react-wrapper/skills && test -f $SOURCE/pds-knowledge-react/SKILL.md || { echo 'Missing staged react skill. Run npm run build:skills first.' >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf $TARGET && cp -r $SOURCE $TARGET
scripts.build:subPackages:skill:bin: SOURCE=../storefront/projects/skills/bin/pds-skill.js && TARGET=./dist/react-wrapper/bin && test -f $SOURCE || { echo "Missing canonical pds-skill binary at $SOURCE." >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p $TARGET && rm -f $TARGET/pds-skill.js && cp $SOURCE $TARGET/pds-skill.js && chmod +x $TARGET/pds-skill.js
scripts.build:typings: DEST=./dist/react-wrapper && SRC=$DEST/esm && mv $SRC/jsdom-polyfill/index.d.ts $DEST/jsdom-polyfill/index.d.ts && rm -rf $SRC/jsdom-polyfill && mv $SRC/partials/index.d.ts $DEST/partials/esm/index.d.ts && rm -rf $SRC/partials && mv $SRC/tokens/index.d.ts $DEST/tokens/esm/index.d.ts && rm -rf $SRC/tokens && mv $SRC/testing/index.d.ts $DEST/testing/index.d.ts && rm -rf $SRC/testing && mv $SRC/meta/index.d.ts $DEST/meta/esm/index.d.ts && rm -rf $SRC/meta && npm run build:typings:emotion && npm run build:typings:vanilla-extract && npm run build:typings:ag-grid
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:vrt
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:react-wrapper && npm run test:unit:react-ssr-wrapper
